Building with AI and the road ahead

takeaways: Power Apps code apps let citizen developers build polished React-based apps with natural language while pro developers extend the same code with tools like Claude Code or the GitHub CLI.
Low code does not mean low discipline: licensing, DLP policies, permissions and governance still apply to code apps inside the Power Platform guardrails.
Not every problem needs an agent; identifying process steps and real use cases decides whether an app, a flow or a Copilot agent is the right answer.
hook: Power Apps code apps are blurring the line between low-code and pro-code development. This episode is for Power Platform makers, pro developers and IT teams deciding how to build and govern modern business apps. Microsoft MVP Carike Botha explains what code apps are, where they fit next to Copilot agents and how to keep them enterprise-ready.
